75af5ae0c21f28e39971653e17deb2c4250b3602: Abondance is a small-scale, low-key resort: 25 km of pistes for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Abondance's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a good-natured atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Abondance's modest altitude, with the village at 930 m and the summit at 1730 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. The day lift pass at 28€ remains reasonable for the quality of the ski area on offer. Counting accommodation, skiing and meals, Abondance suits those who want to spend a lovely week without the final bill making them fall off their chair. In short: Abondance is one of those rare resorts that combines a real village, a sincere family atmosphere and pistes suited to everyone. It's hard to have a bad stay here.
